# How to save Codeforces pages (do this first, about 15 minutes)

The AI cannot open Codeforces. These saved pages are its only source of selectors. Without them it will guess.

## For each page below
1. Open the page in Chrome, **logged out** (no personal info in the files).
2. Wait until it fully loads.
3. Press **Ctrl+S** (Cmd+S on Mac), choose **Webpage, Complete**, and save into this folder.
   Name the file exactly as in the table (`home.html`, etc.). Keep the matching `_files` folder if Chrome makes one.
4. Tick the box in `STATUS.md`.

| File name | Page to open |
|---|---|
| `home.html` | https://codeforces.com/ |
| `problemset.html` | https://codeforces.com/problemset |
| `problem.html` | any problem, e.g. https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/4/A |
| `contest.html` | any finished contest page, e.g. https://codeforces.com/contest/1 |
| `contest-problem.html` | a problem inside a contest, e.g. https://codeforces.com/contest/1/problem/A |
| `standings.html` | a standings page, e.g. https://codeforces.com/contest/1/standings |
| `submissions.html` | e.g. https://codeforces.com/contest/1/status |
| `profile.html` | any public profile, e.g. https://codeforces.com/profile/tourist |
| `blog.html` | any public blog post |
| `login.html` | https://codeforces.com/enter |

Optional: `groups.html`, `contests-list.html`.

## Tips
- If Codeforces shows a "checking your browser" page, wait until it passes, then save.
- Also take a screenshot of each page (`home.png`, etc.) so you can compare before and after.
- Remove anything private (your handle, email). Logged-out pages are best.
- Re-save the pages if Codeforces changes its design and styling starts to break.
